facts.authority: Massachusetts Department of Family and Medical Leave
Massachusetts Department of Family and Medical Leave

facts.value: Accrual: 1 hour of paid sick leave per 30 hours worked on or in connection with a covered contract; a contractor may cap accrual at not less than 56 hours per accrual year. Caveat: the DOL WHD EO 13706 page returned 404 and the current status of EO 13706 itself was not established from an official source; eCFR still carries 29 CFR 13.5 as of 2026-11-01.

Employer coverage: 50 or more employees for 20 or more workweeks in the current or preceding calendar year (825.104). Employee eligibility: 12 months of employment, 1,250 hours in the prior 12 months, worksite with 50 or more employees within 75 miles (825.110).
facts.note: Closes RQ-517 (V11). Register: US-FEDV6-014, US-FEDV6-015, US-FEDV6-016

facts.value: An employer-paid supplement is employer sick pay: employee and employer FICA and FUTA apply, and income tax withholding is mandatory. Caveat: Pub. 15-A does not mention State PFML/TDI explicitly; the answer rests on the general sick-pay rule. The State-paid benefit is not employer wages (not addressed in the publication read). W-2 box reporting not separately quoted.
